items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I had the group behind the Josephine Baker show, you know, my brother and I

ctx.x: You know, to get up in the middle of a tune and walk off?

Well one thing I can say about Duke I mean he was not a disciplinarian. By no means. He’d say, “Everybody’s a man.” Or he didn’t fire you, and I mean well he gave one guy notice, that was the first time I’d ever seen that. But anyway, okay now what happened to me, I had met him when I was like in Paris you know. I had the group behind the Josephine Baker show, you know, my brother and I, and the old Olympia Theater like in Paris. So and the band was like in town so they came by the see the group. And they just…
couldn’t make them. So he called me up for one weekend, you know to make Friday, Saturday, Sunday, over in Cherry Hill, New Jersey you know.
